author.en-US: Third Plenary Council of Baltimore; supplemented by Rev. Thomas L. Kinkead
author.pt-BR: Terceiro Concílio Plenário de Baltimore; completado pelo Pe. Thomas L. Kinkead

description.en-US: A Catechism of Christian Doctrine, No. 3, for the two years' course of post-confirmation classes: the 421 questions of No. 2 (marked with their No. 2 numbers) with some 980 further questions and answers added by Fr Thomas L. Kinkead from his Explanation, 1,400 in all, on the prayers, the 37 lessons and the Christian life.
description.pt-BR: Catecismo da Doutrina Cristã nº 3, para o curso de dois anos das classes pós-crisma: as 421 perguntas do nº 2 (indicadas com a numeração do nº 2) com cerca de 980 perguntas e respostas acrescentadas pelo Pe. Thomas L. Kinkead a partir de sua Explicação, 1.400 ao todo, sobre as orações, as 37 lições e a vida cristã.

sources.description: Project Gutenberg #14553, 'A Catechism of Christian Doctrine, No. 3' (Benziger; imprimaturs New York 1885, 1901 and 29 June 1921; transcription by Dennis McCarthy from catholic.net files). The transcriber marks the Council's questions with their No. 2 numbers in braces; they appear here as '(No. 2: n)'. Tier A: public domain in the United States (1891 text; printing of 1921). Transcriber's notes and the Gutenberg licence removed. Question 630 lacks its 'A.' marker in the source; the answer was recovered from the text.
